mouthpiece: Possibly orig. ext. diameter of rim 33.3, rim 4.1, total length 65, throat 4.8 stem 44, exit 9.0.
dimensions: bo1 9.3, le 2571, be 114, h 1070, slide sec. 1591, bell sec. 2570, overlap 34, rim wire 3.8, h 1070, bell sec. 1013, height of bell sec., 685; height of slide section 850, bell sec. entry 11, neckpipe at bow 12, bell pipe at bow 12.
remarks: Very good condition. Tubular slide stays. Ferrules variable in design. Mp receiver has flare, outer slide tube has wider piece 70 long extending below moveable stay. Solder repair at junction of ferrule of asc. tube and bow. Four rivets visible on left-hand side of immoveable slide stay. Saddles on bell bow, slide bow, with common zigzag pattern but no ring; termination of bell is separate piece, 37mm long—joint visible inside bell; flat bell-stay, in unusual undulating pattern, no decorations, no eyelet. Bell has considerable terminal flare. Examined by the author June 1999.
